An '''Imperial Army pilot''' served under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Orlok]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] individual [[Vehicle Command Crewer|piloted]] one of three [[Imperial ground-skimmer]]s in a failed [[Battle of Daluuj|effort]] to defeat the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had journeyed to Daluuj to rescue the imperiled [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].
